LDG-POL-PRIVACY.statement: Remaining overlooking in a seated room at most 30 % of the existing overlooking (25 % for the quiet corner)
LDG-POL-PRIVACY.basis: brief: privacy is critical; no published figure (LDK GAP-OVERLOOK-ABOVE); ours

LDG-POL-SHADE.statement: Dining room: at least 50 % of its cells under cover (pergola or evergreen canopy); evening cells sun-free at least 90 %
LDG-POL-SHADE.basis: brief: shade over sun, summer nights; the percentage is the client's (LDK GAP-SHADE-TARGET); ours

LDG-POL-SPREAD.statement: A plant's mature-spread circle may overhang its bed by 0.15 m and must not reach a seat, the door path or the fire-pit clearance
LDG-POL-SPREAD.basis: mature spread against space (LANDSCAPE-METHOD A2); ours

LDG-POL-TOXIC.statement: No toxic species (LDL toxicity_people toxic or highly_toxic) within 2 m of a seat or a herb bed
LDG-POL-TOXIC.basis: Time-Saver Standards 550-3 (poisonous plants out of reach); the 2 m is ours

LDG-POL-HYDRO.statement: One water-need class per planting bed, trees in the bed included
LDG-POL-HYDRO.basis: Time-Saver 750-11 via LS-HYDROZONE; trees added by us

LDG-POL-GEOM.statement: No two elements overlap and all lie inside the zone

LDG-POL-TREEBLDG.statement: NHBC trunk-to-building distance (LS-TREE-BUILDING) is hard here: A2 lists tree-to-foundation distance
